scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r --if-present typecheck && tsc -p tools --noEmit && tsc -p supabase/functions --noEmit
scripts.test: pnpm -r --if-present test && node --test tools/content-pipeline.test.mjs tools/curriculum-view.test.mjs tools/local-backend-setup.test.mjs tools/tutor-interface.test.mjs tools/tutor-benchmark.test.mjs
scripts.check:deno: npx -y deno@2.9.6 check --config tools/deno.json tools/deno-smoke.ts && npx -y deno@2.9.6 run --config tools/deno.json tools/deno-smoke.ts && npx -y deno@2.9.6 check --config supabase/functions/deno.json supabase/functions/learning-sync/index.ts supabase/functions/content-reports/index.ts supabase/functions/access/index.ts supabase/functions/cancellation/index.ts && npx -y deno@2.9.6 check --config supabase/functions/deno.json supabase/functions/motivation/index.ts supabase/functions/reminder-dispatch/index.ts && npx -y deno@2.9.6 run --config supabase/functions/deno.json --allow-env=EXPO_ACCESS_TOKEN tools/push-smoke.ts && pnpm check:tutor && pnpm check:knowledge && pnpm check:tutor:benchmark && pnpm check:billing
scripts.check:tutor: npx -y deno@2.9.6 check --config tools/deno.json tools/tutor-smoke.ts tools/tutor-live.ts supabase/functions/tutor/index.ts && npx -y deno@2.9.6 run --config tools/deno.json --allow-env=ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS tools/tutor-smoke.ts
scripts.check:knowledge: npx -y deno@2.9.6 check --config tools/deno.json tools/knowledge-smoke.ts && npx -y deno@2.9.6 run --config tools/deno.json --allow-env=ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS tools/knowledge-smoke.ts
scripts.check:tutor:benchmark: npx -y deno@2.9.6 check --config tools/deno.json tools/tutor-benchmark-worker.ts tools/tutor-benchmark-smoke.ts && npx -y deno@2.9.6 run --config tools/deno.json --allow-env=ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS tools/tutor-benchmark-smoke.ts
scripts.check:billing: npx -y deno@2.9.6 check --config tools/deno.json tools/billing-smoke.ts tools/billing-server-smoke.ts supabase/functions/billing/index.ts supabase/functions/billing-webhook/index.ts && npx -y deno@2.9.6 run --config tools/deno.json tools/billing-smoke.ts && npx -y deno@2.9.6 run --config tools/deno.json tools/billing-server-smoke.ts
